name: Radiant Swirl
description: A swoosh of color swept from the center outward in one continuous radial gesture, built from stacked rotated rings.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: 50%; @size: 100%; transform: rotate(calc(-2turn / @size * @i)); background: @svg( viewBox: 0 0 100 100; defs { linearGradient { id: gradient; stop { stop-color: var(--color0); offset: 0; } @M10(stop { stop-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); offset: @r.1; }) stop { stop-color: var(--color3); offset: @r1; } stop { stop-color: var(--color4); offset: 1; } } } circle { cx, cy: 50; r: @calc(4.3 + 30 / @size * @i); fill: none; stroke: url(#gradient); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: @r(.5, 1.5); stroke-dasharray: @calc(10 + 90 / @size * @i); } ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
